visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt and black shorts, sits on a light beige sofa. Next to him is a Shiba Inu dog with cream and tan fur, sitting upright. The setting is a modern indoor living room with a mirrored wall panel in the background and soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) The man touches his cheek and gestures toward the dog while speaking. The Shiba Inu looks at the man attentively and raises its right front paw to gently pat the man's cheek. Yellow variety text appears at the top left of the screen, and a social media handle logo is at the bottom right. (3) The man points to his face again, appearing to give another command. The dog suddenly reacts with more energy, lunging forward and swiping its paw forcefully toward the man's head. The man flinches back slightly, reacting to the dog's enthusiastic but sudden physical movement.
